author: Lori Youmshajekian
title: A single course of antibiotics may reshape the gut microbiome for years
description: A study in Sweden found that some antibiotics affected microbial diversity in the gut more than others
content:
Antibiotics are designed to wipe out infection-causing bacteria, but even a single course can leave a lasting mark on the gut microbiome, according to a new study of nearly 15,000 adults in Sweden.
